ATTACHMENT 8: Area(s) of Interest This CSO seeks innovative, commercial approaches to meet various technology objectives of the US Air Force Academy. All items, technologies, and services acquired using a CSO will be treated as commercial items. USAFA-001, LEADERSHIP The US Air Force Academy seeks innovative solutions in holistic leadership skills, airmindedness, space mindedness, and cybermindedness. Leadership topics include:  Developing Warfighters to Win, Leaders of Character and Quality, and Critical Thinkers to Adapt.  Experiential cadet training opportunities that introduce regulated challenges (e.g. fog of war) to develop leadership and resiliency.  Additional details will be provided as a part of any future call seeking commercial solutions under this area of interest.
